CommunityApplications.Profile:
**Unraid templates by Giuseppe Giardina** ([Your Future Me](https://yourfuture.me)).
This repository holds the Community Apps template for [WatchSense](https://github.com/peppeg/watchsense): self-hosted TV series recommendations driven by your own viewing history (Netflix, Prime Video, Stremio, Trakt) and an OpenAI-compatible LLM of your choice, cloud or local. All data stays in a single SQLite file on your server.
The app itself is MIT-licensed and developed at https://github.com/peppeg/watchsense. Bugs and questions: https://github.com/peppeg/watchsense/issues (or Discussions on the same repository).
